Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Keeping track of the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on shouldn't take extra effort every time you open a project. With Saved Views, you can capture any configuration once and return to it instantly, whether that's a sprint board filtered by priority, a calendar grouped by assignee, or a backlog sorted by due date.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room to build out setups for every project, client, or workflow you manage. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to give everyone the same starting point instead of rebuilding filters from scratch or explaining setup steps in chat.

Saved Views works across lists, boards, and calendars, and updates automatically as your data changes, so shared views always stay current for the whole team.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
